entries.title: From a PDF Archive to a Product Graph
entries.dek: We rebuilt 233 legacy PDFs (1,331 pages) into ~1,500 reusable chunks in a semantic graph. Search, AI answer engines, and Rain Bird's own team can now find and reuse the content.

entries.title: How We Version Every Deliverable
entries.dek: Graffold gives every deliverable a full iteration tree and the files it is built from. Trace the studio's own work, and see what a package looks like.

entries.title: A New Map for Product Docs
entries.dek: How AI and knowledge graphs will change product documentation: static PDFs → instructions built on demand.
